name: Page of Wands
meaning_for_today: Today brings curiosity, enthusiasm, and exciting possibilities. A new idea, message, or opportunity may inspire you to explore unfamiliar paths.
card_advice: Stay open to new experiences and trust your creative instincts. Be brave enough to take the first step, even if the outcome is uncertain.

upright.short: Curiosity, inspiration, adventure, enthusiasm, discovery, creativity.
upright.general: The Page of Wands symbolizes fresh energy, creative ideas, and the desire for exploration. This card represents enthusiasm, learning, spontaneity, and the courage to try something new. It often appears when exciting opportunities or messages are approaching.
upright.in_love: In relationships, the Page of Wands points to flirtation, passion, playful communication, and exciting romantic beginnings. It may indicate a youthful or adventurous partner.
upright.in_situation: A situation encourages experimentation, creativity, and openness to change. Success comes through curiosity, flexibility, and willingness to learn.

reversed.short: Immaturity, hesitation, lack of direction, delays, insecurity.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Page of Wands may indicate creative blocks, fear of failure, impatience, or scattered energy. Plans may lack focus or consistency.
reversed.in_love: Relationships may suffer from immaturity, mixed signals, emotional inconsistency, or fear of commitment.
reversed.in_situation: Delays or uncertainty prevent progress. It is important to regain confidence, organize priorities, and avoid acting carelessly.
